content: The customer, Anvi Desai, called after discovering her health policy expired on August 30, 2026. Agent Anita Sharma confirmed the expiration and reviewed three plan options with the customer: standard renewal ($1,200/year), comprehensive plan with dental and vision ($1,500/year), and a basic essential plan ($900/year with higher deductibles). Anvi requested time to review her finances and consider her options, promising to follow up the next day.

action_items: Agent to email the renewal brochure and policy details link
Customer to review finances and follow up tomorrow
